source: Inspired by assets/Corp Deck 2025 - Nov.pptx slide 17 ('… AI-powered solutions don't work "out of the box" / Nearly every company needs help to go the Last Mile for value / That's where we come in!'). The original stacks three statements; this example collapses to the single canonical quote_callout shape (one statement + attribution).
intent: Slow the deck rhythm with a single oversized statement that the audience should remember verbatim. Use for principles, market observations, customer quotes, leadership claims — never for facts that need a metric or a list.
invariants: exactly one quote statement, oversized (hero type style)
exactly one attribution line below the quote (kicker type style, accent_1 color)
thin vertical accent bar on the left edge of the body region
decorative oversized opening quotation glyph in accent_2
no header bar, no metrics, no cards, no bullets
quote text fits in 4 lines or fewer at hero size
variables: attribution source (deck name + date, speaker name + title, or document citation)
vertical bar accent color (any palette accent — typically accent_1)
glyph color (any palette accent that contrasts the bar — typically accent_2)
